title: Copy/move construction and assignment
summary: Assignment `=` navigates to the assignment operator, while copy and move initialization do not
prose:
Go-to-definition on the `=` of an assignment reaches the assignment
operator. The `=` that introduces a copy- or move-initialization
(`T b = a;`) is initialization syntax rather than an operator call and is
not yet resolved.

value.wrong: should reach Widget(const Widget&), the copy constructor the initialization runs
should reach Widget(Widget&&), the move constructor the initialization runs
